newsitem.title: UK: LIBERTY INTL TO LOOK FOR ACQUISITIONS.
newsitem.headline: LIBERTY INTL TO LOOK FOR ACQUISITIONS.

text.p: Liberty International Holdings, the financial services and property group, said on Thursday it might be using a part of its 2.1 billion stg capital resources for acquisitions to boost its financial business.
Liberty, 69 percent owned by South Africa's Liberty Life, reported a pre-tax profit of 100.4 million stg.

Donald Gordon, the chairman of Liberty said its capital resources would "provide strong and stable support for the development of financial services businesses, whether through acquisition or otherwise".
The group ended 1996 with liquid cash of around 456 million stg and shareholders' funds including minority interests and subordinated convertible bonds rose 22 percent to over 2.1 billion stg.
The net asset value per share rose 16 percent to 436 pence per share.
